regions.name: Organic Regions
regions.description: Slowly flowing weighted regions with varied size and density. Supplies shader fragments and controls to a compatible painting renderer without an extra image pass.

watercolor.name: Animated Watercolor
watercolor.description: Slowly shifting blue-green washes and moving warm pools, with regional color contrast, pigment pooling and watercolor blooms. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.

boundary.name: Organic Boundary Ink
boundary.description: Uneven warm outlines, hand-drawn character and stationary paper grain. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.

phrasing.name: Composition Phrasing
phrasing.description: Shared artistic clock, slow tension and release, scale hierarchy, and the painting noise basis. Shader-field for compatible painting renderers.
